eway.title: E-way bill for {{doc}}
eway.help: The e-way bill is made from the posted invoice through the e-way bill API, before the vehicle leaves.

eway.needs_invoice: Make or link the invoice first; the e-way bill is made from it.
eway.already: This dispatch already has an e-way bill.
eway.vehicle: Give the vehicle number or the transporter's GSTIN.

einvoice.irn_required: The invoice needs its IRN first (e-invoicing is on for the GSTIN).

dispatch.eway_invalid: This dispatch's e-way bill is cancelled or no longer valid.

integrations.provider_not_set: No e-way bill provider is chosen yet. The owner picks it on Settings.
integrations.mock_not_allowed: The mock provider works only on the development database.
